resume: Oryn and Sable arrived at Ashveil Crossing at dusk to find The Amber Toll already tense. Petra Dawnhollow served them supper and cold iron tea without being asked — old habit. Mosswick's runner Wren was there, pale and barely coherent, clutching a note. The Veil was visible as a grey smear to the east where Thornwick should have been lit up by suppertime lanterns. Oryn read the note and asked the right questions; Sable heard something moving in the mist at the treeline around midnight — not an animal. The session ended with Petra drawing a chalk circle around the inn while Sable stood watch, and Oryn sitting at the bar copying Wren's account of the last three days into their journal. Tomorrow: Thornwick.

actions.action: Reads Mosswick's note carefully and asks Wren three targeted questions about the charter
actions.resultat: Learns that Mosswick knows where the charter is but won't retrieve it alone; suspects Mosswick is hiding something personal

actions.action: Watches Wren while Oryn questions her — uses Insight to read the runner's body language
actions.resultat: Confirms Wren is not a mist-shade (no blank pauses, genuine distress); also picks up that Wren is more afraid of Mosswick than of the Veil, which is interesting

actions.action: Pays for supper and asks Petra about the cold-iron horseshoe above the door
actions.resultat: Petra tells the story of her father's disappearance; mentions the verse he used to sing but cannot quite remember it — 'something about the mist asking and the stone answering'

actions.action: Steps outside after midnight to listen at the treeline
actions.resultat: WISDOM SAVE DC 12 — rolled 17. Hears two fog-wraiths conversing in the Veil-tongue: 'The readers have come. The Court is watching.' Retreats to the inn without being detected. Reports to Oryn.

actions.action: Proposes helping Petra draw the chalk circle correctly (Investigation DC 12 on the old instructions Petra half-remembers)
actions.resultat: INVESTIGATION — rolled 14. Identifies the correct proportions and supplements Petra's chalk with iron filings from the smithy ash-heap. Circle is properly made.

actions.action: Stands watch while Oryn and Petra draw the circle
actions.resultat: The mist does not advance past the treeline. The inn is safe for the night.

lieux_visites.note: Base of operations for now. Petra is an ally. Chalk circle now surrounds the building.

lieux_visites.nom: The drover's road east of Ashveil
lieux_visites.note: Players arrived this way. The road vanishes into the Veil about half a mile east.
Oryn borrowed iron filings from the ash-heap. Smithy is closed but unlocked.

pnj_rencontres.relation_niveau: Friendly — helped draw the circle; trusts the players are competent
pnj_rencontres.note: Mentioned her father (a collected soul, unknown to her). The verse she half-remembers may be a ritual ward — to follow up.

pnj_rencontres.relation_niveau: Neutral — delivered the note, answered questions, has nothing more to give
pnj_rencontres.note: Afraid of Mosswick specifically. Why? Sable noticed; Oryn noted it. To investigate.

etat_fin.phase: Both players at The Amber Toll. Chalk circle complete. Wren asleep upstairs.
etat_fin.oryn_inventaire_note: Journal now contains Wren's full account of the last 3 days in Thornwick. Added a note: 'Mosswick is afraid of something more specific than the Veil.'
etat_fin.sable_inventaire_note: Veil-sense is active and elevated — the hum is louder than usual. Grey silk ribbon feels warmer than it should.
etat_fin.situation_veil: The Veil is at the treeline east of Ashveil. It advanced to that point around midnight and has not moved since. The chalk circle is holding.
pistes_en_cours: Wren's specific fear of Mosswick — what did she see or hear in Thornwick?
Petra's half-remembered verse — a ward or a key?
The fog-wraiths' message: 'The readers have come. The Court is watching.' — the Court already knows about the players
The charter is apparently at the village well — but why won't Mosswick retrieve it alone?
Sable's grey silk ribbon is warmer than it should be in cold weather

teaser: Somewhere in Thornwick, Mosswick is counting names on a list and running out of time. The Veil will be thicker tomorrow. Whatever Wren saw in the Elder's face before she ran — it wasn't just the mist she was afraid of.
